mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_job (id, prd_id, prd_version_id, rubric_id, status, model_profile, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{prdId}, #{prdVersionId}, #{rubricId}, #{status}, #{modelProfile}, #{createdBy}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT id, prd_id, prd_version_id, rubric_id, status, model_profile, error_message, created_by, started_at, finished_at, created_at FROM review_job WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT count(*) FROM review_job WHERE prd_id = #{prdId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE review_job SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = now(), error_message = '本地服务中断，评审未完成，请重新发起' WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
UPDATE review_job SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT j.id, j.prd_id, j.prd_version_id, j.rubric_id, j.status, j.model_profile, j.error_message, j.created_by, j.started_at, j.finished_at, j.created_at, v.version_no, r.overall_score, r.readiness, r.summary, rubric.name AS rubric_name, rubric.version AS rubric_version FROM review_job j JOIN prd_version v ON v.id = j.prd_version_id JOIN review_rubric rubric ON rubric.id = j.rubric_id LEFT JOIN review_report r ON r.review_job_id = j.id WHERE j.prd_id = #{prdId} ORDER BY j.created_at DESC
